before-transformers.title: Before Transformers
before-transformers.blurb: How did machines learn to read? Not with transformers. Long before attention, there was a small, honest chain of ideas: telegraph codes, a matrix of counts, a dot product, softmax, and one absurdly clean gradient. These ten chapters build the whole chain from scratch, with interactive toys to poke at in every one. If you've ever nodded along to the word "embeddings" without quite believing yourself, start at chapter one.
